Application

Tuition and Financial Aid
Application
The application process is entirely online through the Cornell University Graduate School. See Chemical Engineering Ph.D. (Ithaca) Field of Study for the application deadline, requirements, fees and payment options.
When filling out the application, the proposed field of study and program name is “Chemical Engineering, Ph.D.”
Admission Decisions
Applications are evaluated after the deadline and students will be notified electronically of admission decisions typically by late February/early March, but no later than mid-May. Admission is determined by faculty members in the applicant’s chosen field.
Admission is based solely on academic merit. Financial need plays no role in the admission procedure. Completed applications and all accompanying online materials received by January 7 will be automatically considered for financial aid. A separate financial aid application is not needed.
Tuition and Financial Aid
Substantial financial aid is available to outstanding Ph.D. applicants. All students admitted to the Ph.D. program receive full financial aid in the form of a full tuition waiver, stipend, and health insurance, either from a fellowship, research assistantship, or teaching assistantship. Full stipends are given for nine months; additional summer support is usually available.
Information regarding current application fees and payment options, tuition rate and financial aid can be found at the Graduate School website and the following pages.
